title: Outlook mobile: refreshed Copilot Chat sheet with the new and temporary chat button moved behind the ... menu
summary: The briefing passes: its planned mobile interface changes and rollout target match the roadmap, and its licensing and admin paths match Microsoft documentation. It accurately reports the conflicting guidance about Teams and leaves the refresh's default state and undocumented automation unresolved.

claims.where: controls[0].governs; controls[1].governs; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: Integrated Apps availability controls on the Copilot app govern access to Copilot Chat in Outlook.
claims.quote: The Copilot app provides Copilot Chat in the Microsoft Copilot app and Outlook across web, desktop, and mobile, and on the web at m365.cloud.microsoft/chat. You manage the app through the Integrated Apps portal in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: The Integrated Apps guide says its documented controls are only available to Global Admins.
claims.quote: The following controls on the integrated apps portal in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center are only available to Global Admins.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The block control is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Integrated Apps > Available Apps > app > Block app.
claims.quote:
Select Settings, and then select Integrated Apps.
Select the Available Apps list.
Select an app from the Available Apps list to open the overview pane.
Select Block app.

claims.claim: The group availability control is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Integrated Apps > Available Apps > app > Users > Specific users/group in the organization can install.
claims.quote:
Select Settings, then select Integrated Apps.
Select the Available Apps list.
Next, select the app you want to edit.
select the Users tab in the overview pane.
Specific users/group in the organization can install

claims.quote: This setting blocks Copilot in the Microsoft Copilot app, Teams, Outlook, and Copilot Chat on the web for all users.

claims.claim: The specific-users/group availability option restricts self-installation and use to the selected users.

claims.claim: The app availability setting does not affect admin-deployed apps.
claims.quote: The availability setting of an app doesn't impact any admin deployed apps. The availability setting only allows you to control which end users can install and use these apps on their own.
